# A card that names no consumer value cannot reach Ready
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #317, sha256:930f5e30c0c37383a9a2b2767e912ae1796700c0c97f65e788a090c4cd8f7ce7). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (the product owner's value rule and card format rule, applied to the Ready check)
- **Source:** the product owner's rulings of 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07: no issue is worked without value to a consumer actor, mob roles are never actors, and every issue carries a Connextra story with Gherkin scenarios whose titles tag the ZOMBIES letters they cover; a card that silently skips a letter is not Ready. The working agreement now carries both rules as text (the Value rule and the Card format rule); the mechanical half of the Ready check (scripts/check-story-persona.py and the Contract branch of scripts/board/new_card.py) accepts a Contract whose actor is a component, a story that names any persona, and criteria with no scenario format. This card answers the card-format question (card 309 was closed as resolved by the ruling).
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Steve, I want a card that names no consumer value, names a mob role as its actor, has no Gherkin scenarios, or skips a ZOMBIES letter without a reason, refused before it can be Ready, so that no work is spent on waste and I do not have to catch it at a re-rank.
- **One user-observable outcome:** Steve tries to file or ready a card that breaks one of the rules and the check names the rule and the card.
- **Acceptance criteria (Gherkin; ZOMBIES letter in each title):**
  1. Scenario: [Z] a card with no scenarios is refused. Given a draft with a Story line and no "Scenario:" blocks, When the Ready check runs, Then it fails and says the Gherkin scenarios are missing.
  2. Scenario: [O] a card in the full format passes. Given a draft whose Story names a consumer actor (Steve, Morgan, Dana, Ari, or Riley for dogfooding) and whose scenarios tag all seven letters, When the Ready check runs, Then it passes.
  3. Scenario: [M] [B] coverage is checked letter by letter. Given scenarios that tag six of Z, O, M, B, I, E, S, When the check runs, Then it fails and names the missing letter; a one-line "Letter X does not apply: <reason>" in the card lets that letter pass, and the reviewer must agree.
  4. Scenario: [I] the actor rule is enforced. Given a Story line that starts "As the facilitator" (or a driver, a reviewer seat, the agile coach, the audit lens, the Decider, a script, CI or the board), When the Ready check runs, Then it fails and names the invalid actor; a Contract with no `Consumer value:` line naming a persona and the value fails the same way.
  5. Scenario: [E] [S] the board is checked as a whole. Given the open cards above the line, When the check runs over the board, Then every one passes the rules and any card that fails is listed with the rule it breaks.
- **Not in this card:** closing or migrating existing cards (a card is brought into the format when it is pulled for its Ready step); adding any persona for a mob role; the mob-defaults copy (card 318).

## Context

- Filed by the facilitator on 2026-11-06 at re-rank 26 and rewritten on 2026-11-07 to carry the card format ruling (Gherkin with ZOMBIES letters), which the earlier text did not have.
